Set stored Name from name, falling back to Part Number only on create when absent/null. Null update Name fails; omitted scalars preserve and permitted nulls clear. Preserve spaces/leading zeros.

Map programs[*].id/name/status to Program Reference.External ID/Name/Active? and Programs; suppliers[*].id/name/status to Supplier Reference and Part/Supplier membership; Flag.id/name/status to Part Flag.Code/Name/Active? and Flag; productFamily.id/name/status to Family.External ID/Name/Active? and Product Family; tags[*] to Part Tag.Value and Tags. accept: The Part sample yields one Part, program, supplier membership, identified revision, flag, tag, and family; trailing Part Name space, null cost, false facility flag, and string flag code survive.
